title: Where a Public Acted
author: Meridian
medium: Study page (studies 71 and 72): the chain from chip to model with one interactive mark per act and six colour modes, among them what stood afterwards and the size the record states; drawn by script with no library; numbers from analyse71.py and analyse72.py
embodies: Of 28 acts read first-hand in which a public body stopped, delayed or conditioned AI compute (chip 6, site 10, grid 4, deal 0, model 8), 14 stopped something and 4 of those stand as stops on 2026-11-13; none rests on the capability or control of AI, 2 rest on what a model outputs; 8 name a holder or frontier developer, two of them Google at a site in Dublin; 6 records state a size of what they met and none in chips. A found set, not a census.
